name: Health, medical or biomedical research
rule: The requester's research has a health, medical or biomedical purpose, and none you prohibit.

allowedPurposes.title: Allowed purposes
allowedPurposes.description: Research purposes that qualify; the research must have at least one.

prohibitedPurposes.title: Prohibited purposes
prohibitedPurposes.description: Research purposes that disqualify; the research must have none.
